## Guide
**Keep Entity Icons Visible**
1. Enter your world and press "Y" to open the "Minimap Settings".
2. Select "Entity Radar Settings".
3. Change "Display Icons" to "Always".
4. Adjust "Entity Icon Scale" to a size that‘s convenient for you.

**Display Only Pokémon Icons**
1. Enter .minecraft/config/xaero/minimap folder and open "default_radar_categories_client.json".
2. Replace `"hardInclude": "anything"` with `"hardInclude": "nothing"`
3. Replace `"includeList": []` with `"includeList": ["cobblemon:pokemon"]`

**Using With Other Packs**
- [Combee MC Remodel](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/combee-mc-remodel) should be placed above this pack.
- All ​​other​​ packs ​​should​​ be placed​​ under this pack.



## Credit
- Pokémon sprites are from [MBCMechachu](https://www.deviantart.com/mbcmechachu). His page has extensive credits for each contributed artists.

### [1.4.2] - 2026/1/15
- Fixed Furfrou icon issues and added icons for the 6 new cosmetics variants from the 1.7 update.
- Fixed Smeargle's tail color being stuck as green and red (for shiny). (lolnebby)
- Adapted Navas' ZAmega (algodaodoce). Added za mega icons created by a team of talented artists (see full credits: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kI_PDXnbghxjN2LBvxA6Pz-QqMYlVGN3Z1EivXOYwNY/edit?gid=1051438000#gid=1051438000). Some mega icons are still missing and use their base forms as placeholders; these will be updated later.
- Updated the following Pokémon's icons to match MBCMechachu's sprites: Rabsca, Palafin, Koraidon, Miraidon, Dipplin, Hydrapple, Terapagos.
- Added compatibility for MundialMons ReaniPack and new galarian Mime Jr. icons (MBCMechachu!).
- Adapted more ATMxMSD cobblemon variants (karen7597). Added icons for shadow Mewtwo and Mewtwo Mega X (shadow mega y still uses the mega y icon for now).
- Added compatibility for Cobbled Variants. Variant icons drawn by the addon author zac_lyor! Including metal variants for the Beldum line, tree variants for the Phantump line, and axolotl color variants for the Wooper line.
- Brightened the flower color for the green Flabebe & Floette icon from Flower Expansion and removed unnecessary texture files to reduce pack size.
- Added missing alolan Raichu to the "shiny_raw" folder.
- Updated compatibility for Baby Legends 2.2.
- Updated the unique mark system. Since there are now too many forms (unique, cosmetics, etc.), the golden exclamation mark was becoming redundant. From now on, the exclamation mark is removed for any icon that is visually different from its base form. It will only be kept for forms that use the exact same sprite as the original to help distinguish them.

- Can't wait to see new info about Pokémon Gen 10 on Pokémon's 30th Anniversary!

### [1.4.0] - 2025/12/28
- Fixed Ho-Oh, alolan Grimer, alolan Muk, lowkey Toxtricity, and galarian Weezing not appearing on the minimap.
- Added hat form variants for Pichu, Pikachu, and Raichu, along with several new cosmic forms.
- Added Jigglypuff and Alakazam variants from pokemopolis.
- Added Gimmighoul and Gholdengo variants featuring different apricorn colors.
- Added cosmic variants for Timburr and Komala with different log types.
- Added missing cyan color variant for Conkeldurr.
- Added icons for antique Sinistea/Polteageist, artisan Poltchageist, and masterpiece Sinistcha. While they currently look identical, you can manually add markings to the icons to distinguish them.
- Added the ender pearl form for Spoink.
- Added the alolan regional form for Koffing.
- Updated Cobblemon textures, certain model errors should now be resolved.
- Removed the unique mark from cosmic variants, as they are temporarily not being treated as unique forms.
- Brightened the log colors in Timburr's icons for better visibility.
- Adjusted the concrete colors for different Conkeldurr variants to match the upcoming MBC big icon version.
- Apologies for the delay as it’s been a busy end of the year. Not all new forms from the 1.7 implementation are finished yet, so expect continuous updates over the next few weeks. I will be working on full compatibility with 1.7 and updating the MBC big icon version. Also, the new Megas from Pokémon Legends: Z-A look amazing, so Mega Showdown compatibility is next on the list.
- Special thanks to MBCMechachu!
